Proposition
[Euler characteristic under covers] 1. 13.3.4\group surfaces Source: thurston:page-0329

If $\widetilde O\to O$ is a $k$-sheeted covering orbifold, then $\chi (\widetilde O)=k\chi (O)$.
Proof

\sketch Lift a subordinate cell division and count the $k$ copies of each weighted cell, preserving isotropy weights.

□
